title: Skew
summary: SKEW, adverb Awry; obliquely. [See Askew.] SKEW, verb transitive 1. To look obliquely upon; to notice slightly. [Not in use.] 2. To shape or form in an oblique way. [Not in use.] SKEW, verb intransiti
